name: io.github.Zw-awa/ssh-session-mcp
title: SSH Session MCP
description: Shared SSH PTY runtime for MCP clients with viewer, input lock, async tracking, and policy rules.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit path to ssh-session-mcp.config.json when the config is not in the current working directory.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional runtime state root directory used for viewer state, server info, and per-instance logs.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Optional runtime instance id used to isolate state across multiple MCP clients or agents.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_RUNTIME_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Runtime topology mode. Use distributed to enable a shared control plane, remote-owner routing, and proxy-auth viewer access.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Distributed state store backend. memory is for local skeleton testing only; redis is required for multi-node distributed mode.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_REDIS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Redis connection URL used when SSH_MCP_RUNTIME_MODE=distributed and SSH_MCP_STORE=redis.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_NODE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Stable logical node id advertised in distributed mode. Defaults to the runtime instance id when unset.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public viewer base URL for this replica. Used to build remote-owner redirects and routing hints.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Viewer auth mode. Use proxy to trust authenticated identity headers from a front proxy in distributed deployments.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_TRUST_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Enable trusted proxy header parsing for viewer identity. Recommended only behind a controlled reverse proxy.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_AUTH_USER_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: HTTP header name used to read the authenticated viewer user when SSH_MCP_AUTH_MODE=proxy.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_AUTH_ROLE_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: HTTP header name used to read the authenticated viewer roles when SSH_MCP_AUTH_MODE=proxy.

environmentVariables.name: VIEWER_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Viewer HTTP port. Use auto to allocate a free local port, or 0 to disable the browser viewer.

environmentVariables.name: VIEWER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Optional viewer bind host. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 for local-only browser access.

environmentVariables.name: AUTO_OPEN_TERMINAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to true or 1 to automatically open the browser terminal when a session is created.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Operation mode. safe blocks risky or unsuitable terminal actions by default, while full allows broader execution.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_LOCAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to true or 1 to run a local shell instead of opening a real SSH connection. Useful for demos and offline testing.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to true or 1 to expose browser-side debug controls intended for demos and local troubleshooting.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-target SSH host when not using ssh-session-mcp.config.json device profiles.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-target SSH port when not using ssh-session-mcp.config.json device profiles.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_USER
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-target SSH username when not using ssh-session-mcp.config.json device profiles.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional legacy password-based SSH authentication value.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a file whose contents are used as the legacy SSH password. Useful for Docker or Kubernetes secrets.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a local SSH private key file for legacy single-target mode.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a file whose contents are used as the legacy SSH private key. Useful for Docker or Kubernetes secrets.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_LOG_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Runtime metadata logging mode. Use stderr in containers to avoid persisting files while keeping stdio MCP transport intact.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_LOG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory used for JSONL metadata logs when SSH_MCP_LOG_MODE=meta.
